reviews.text:
We hired Coralie to look after our cat for a week and we were thrilled! 🐱

Everything went perfectly. Coralie took excellent care of our cat, which allowed us to fully enjoy our vacation, with complete peace of mind, knowing he was in good hands. It's truly wonderful to be able to leave with peace of mind, knowing your cat's well-being is guaranteed.

Thank you so much to Coralie for her trust and professionalism! We will gladly use her services again and recommend her without hesitation 😊

Coralie is, in my opinion, one of the best pet sitters in Lyon! Her training as a feline behaviorist allows her to truly understand cats and adapt to each individual. Furthermore, she is very reliable, punctual, and will always prioritize your pets' well-being. She's also wonderful with dogs 🥹

If you're looking for a professional you can trust completely, I highly recommend her.

Thank you, Coralie, for taking such good care of Lyon's furry friends 🐶🐱🥹

I hired CoraKali to look after our two guinea pigs. Absolutely no complaints, everything was perfect! Coralie is very conscientious. We will definitely continue to use her services for our future absences!

We use Coralie to look after Malow while we're away, and we're absolutely delighted! She regularly sends us photos, follows all our instructions perfectly, and really takes the time to make sure everything is alright.
Thanks to her, we can leave with complete peace of mind, knowing that Malow is in good hands. It's a real pleasure to be able to rely on someone so caring, reliable, and gentle with him.
We recommend her without hesitation! 😊

I highly recommend Corakali for her professionalism and pleasant manner, both with us and with our cat, whom she looked after during our vacation.

We left with complete peace of mind.

Thank you 👍

This was my first time using a professional pet sitter. I will definitely use Corakali again; she took excellent care of our cat. We received updates every day and had a very relaxing vacation.
Corakali is very professional and has a deep love for cats.

Coralie is absolutely exceptional! She took wonderful care of my cats during my 15-day vacation, visiting them regularly at my home. From our very first contact, I was immediately put at ease by her kindness, professionalism, and love of animals.

With each visit, I received updates, photos, and videos, which allowed me to enjoy a worry-free vacation. Upon my return, I found my cats relaxed, cuddled, and pampered. It's a real joy knowing they were in good hands.

I wholeheartedly recommend Coralie and wouldn't hesitate to use her services again. Thank you so much for everything!
I highly recommend CoraKali: she is very attentive, meticulous, and highly experienced. She took care of my elderly and very sick cat, and I was very satisfied. Very professional.

Coralie has been taking care of our cat every time we're away for several years now, and we're delighted. We always receive updates about our cat with videos and photos, so we can leave with complete peace of mind.

I highly recommend her 😊
Thank you so much 😊 I really enjoyed taking care of Optimus and Bumblebee 🩷 …
Very professional, everything went very well, I recommend!
Coralie has been taking care of my Riio for several years. I trust her completely, and Riio adores her. You can go on vacation with complete peace of mind!

Corakali looked after our little Pepper for the second time for a week. She's very professional, she played well with our cat, and we receive photos and videos after each visit. Everything is going wonderfully, we're very happy, and we highly recommend her!

CoraKali has been visiting our cat regularly, every time we travel, for the past two years. She's someone we trust completely; she's very gentle and patient and takes care of our cat exactly as we ask. The visits always include video updates, which is really great for getting news about our pet while we're away!

We highly recommend her.

I highly recommend CoraKali! Very professional, attentive, and a great listener. I found my pet in perfect health and calm. It was a real pleasure to be able to leave with complete peace of mind. Thank you again! 😃 …

Coralie is the best at looking after your favorite cat.
Before, I'd come back from vacation and she'd give me the cold shoulder as if I'd fled the country.
Now, she purrs as if I've finally become a decent human.
I even think she prefers Coralie… but I pretend not to notice.

Coralie has been walking our dog for several months now, and we highly recommend her! She's attentive to each animal's needs and very loving with our little companions! And above all, we have complete peace of mind during every walk; we can trust her implicitly!

Coralie understood and loved our cocker spaniel puppy and continues to have lunch with her three times a week!

I highly recommend her.

I used CoraKali to look after my cat. Everything went very well; I received updates and photos/videos after each visit. I found my cat in great shape, even though he's usually very anxious! Delighted with the service. I highly recommend them. My cat was pampered.

CoraKali is a top-notch service. I leave my senior cat with her with complete confidence; she's truly professional, very responsive, and answers all my questions quickly. She sends daily messages with videos and photos while we're away. I highly recommend her! (And so does my cat!)
Coralie is a fantastic pet sitter; she's caring and very reliable. When we go on vacation, we can leave with complete peace of mind 😊 …

During the initial visit, she showed great attention to detail and took copious notes. A huge thank you! We will definitely use her services again whenever necessary and highly recommend her!

Hello,
